experiment_data.notes: D019: GRPO Stage 2 v2 Standard (negative control) — EXIT_CODE=129 (SIGHUP) at step 33/250 (~4h05m, retry_count=1). Confirmed grad_norm=0 collapse: sampling mode (temp=0.7) produces degenerate output ("#### 7248" repeated), reward=0.00, 0 gradient. Despite SFT restoring 64% greedy accuracy and 99% EOS, GRPO sampling destabilizes the pruned model into repetitive loops. Same root cause as RASP counterpart — GRPO method failure, not model-specific.
